Cryptography

Ticket di sessione

A data structure issued by a server to a client in TLS to enable stateless session resumption by encapsulating keying material and session state, reducing handshake overhead.

Quick answer: A data structure issued by a server to a client in TLS to enable stateless session resumption by encapsulating keying material and session state, reducing handshake overhead.

Definition

A data structure issued by a server to a client in TLS to enable stateless session resumption by encapsulating keying material and session state, reducing handshake overhead.

Operational example

With session tickets, clients can resume TLS connections without a full handshake, improving performance and scalability.

Localized term
